Title: CompileHub v1.0 • Quark Released!
Update_Log:
🚀 Welcome to CompileHub v1.0 • Quark!

Core IDE & Engine:
• High-performance GapBuffer editing engine with zero lag
• Smart Java & XML code completion with auto-import
• Code folding, syntax highlighting, regex search & replace

Compiler & Build Tools:
• Instant APK compilation powered by ECJ (Java 11) & R8 minifier
• AAPT & AAPT2 resource compiler with multi-module support

Visual Designer & Intelligence:
• Drag & Drop visual XML layout builder with live inspector
• Live XML Vector Drawable & image previewer
• Code usage finder, symbol lookup, and local revision history

Developer Utilities:
• Built-in Linux Terminal with customizable extra keys
• Integrated Gemini AI Assistant for smart code generation
• APK Signer supporting V1, V2, V3 signature schemes
